main.description: BSAF v1 compatibility: the original tag and language arrays of a Bluesky Structured Alert Feed post, with optional references to the original post and the bot definition. Tags are preserved verbatim; parsed values are not duplicated.

tags.description: Same order and strings as app.bsky.feed.post.tags, including bsaf:v1, the core tags and any unknown additional tags. Limits follow the official app.bsky.feed.post Lexicon.

langs.description: Languages of the BSAF text. For imports, the original post's langs.

original.description: Present when the post was imported from an existing BSAF post. Absent for posts created natively.

botDefinition.description: Bot definition that interprets the BSAF metadata.

originalPost.description: Reference to the original app.bsky.feed.post record. The CID identifies the retrieved content; a different CID at the same URI is different content.

uri.description: at:// URI with the author DID as authority and collection app.bsky.feed.post.

cid.description: CID of the retrieved original record.

createdAt.description: createdAt of the original record, preserved as the original string.

retrievedAt.description: When the importer retrieved this definition. UTC with an uppercase Z suffix.

sha256.description: SHA-256 over the raw bytes of the retrieved JSON document, before any re-serialization.
